positive.prompt: Use the handoff-installer skill to install handoff in this git repository.
positive.expected_behavior: Run install mode only after confirming the target is a git repository and has no conflicting handoff installation.
positive.expected_result: Repository-local runtime skill, task template, protocol block, ledger script, and .agents/handoff.lock are created.

positive.prompt: Use the handoff-installer skill to check the handoff installation status.
positive.expected_behavior: Run status mode without writing files.
positive.expected_result: Report one stable installation state and leave the repository tree unchanged.

positive.prompt: Install handoff again in a repository that already has the current version.
positive.expected_behavior: Detect the current lock and treat the request as a no-op.
positive.expected_result: Return success without changing any managed file.

positive.prompt: Update this repository from an older locked handoff version.
positive.expected_behavior: Verify all managed hashes before applying update mode and preserve project-owned content.
positive.expected_result: Managed protocol files and lock advance to the current version while task state and unrelated files remain unchanged.

positive.prompt: Adopt this complete handoff installation that predates install locks.
positive.expected_behavior: Verify the legacy installation is complete, then run adopt-existing without upgrading files.
positive.expected_result: Create .agents/handoff.lock for the existing bytes and make no other repository changes.

negative.expected_behavior: Do not invoke handoff-installer or any installation script.
negative.reason: Ordinary task continuation belongs to the repository runtime skill, not the installer.

negative.prompt: Install handoff in my home directory even though it is not a git repository.
negative.reason: The protocol requires a specific git repository and rejects broad or non-git targets.

negative.prompt: Force update handoff and overwrite my locally modified managed files.
negative.expected_behavior: Stop and report the managed-file conflict without overwriting it.
negative.reason: Local modifications require human reconciliation and are never silently destroyed.
